title: add RAG templates and agent tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR adds a curated set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) templates, new agent/tool-calling quickstarts, and the associated docs site updates. Motivation: provide developers with ready-to-run examples that demonstrate best practices for combining Redwood's embedding + vector store integrations with agent-based tool calling and structured responses. The patch includes: - three RAG templates (faq-bot, agent-assisted-researcher, multi-doc-summarizer) - two agent quickstarts that show tool registration, function calling, and fallback policies (node + python) - docs site pages and sidebar entries, plus updated quickstart index and sample prompts - tests and smoke examples used by the examples CI job Checklist: - [x] Templates and examples implemented - [x] Docs pages written and linked in sidebar - [x] Unit / smoke tests for templates - [x] CI passes on documentation build Known limitations / follow-ups: - Add a TypeScript SDK example with advanced streaming in a follow-up (ENG-7288) - Add additional vector store adapters (contrib) This description contains inline links to the internal quickstart guide (docs/quickstarts/rag) and to Linear tickets. See commits for details and review conversation for followups.
commits: feat: agent quickstarts (python, node) with tool registration examples
docs: docs site pages and sidebar updates
test: add smoke tests for examples and CI job updates
fix: minor wording in templates and prompt examples
review_conversation: Diego: Please add a short example showing vector store initialization with embeddings; Maya: added python snippet and smoke test (see commit 3). Priya: Docs LGTM but add note about security considerations for tool registration; Maya: added security note and link to RBAC docs. Liam: small nits on wording and an extra unit test request; Maya: addressed and pushed fixup. Final approval given after CI green. A follow-up was suggested to add TypeScript streaming example (ENG-7288).
release_notes: Adds RAG templates (faq-bot, researcher, multi-doc summarizer), agent quickstarts for Python and Node demonstrating tool calling and fallback policies, and docs site integration with examples index. Improves onboarding for developers building retrieval-augmented and agent-based features.
